name: TestUpgradeSuite/TestThreeNodesUpgrade
statusMessage:
Timed out waiting for cluster nodes to become ready in cluster "test-cluster" (device "edge-dev2")

Claude's conclusion:
This confirms the exact same race condition documented previously: all three nodes independently hit "Single node mode prepare config.yaml" within the same second (02:52:43–02:52:44), each bootstrapping its own single-node k3s instead of joining a shared cluster.

Root cause: Live evidence shows all three nodes (`edge-dev1`, `edge-dev2`, `edge-dev3`) independently fell into k3s single-node bootstrap mode — `/persist/kubelog/k3s-install.log` on all three shows `First time for k3s install` / `Single node mode prepare config.yaml for <node>` within the same second (02:52:43–02:52:44), confirming `cluster-init.sh`'s first-boot check lost the race against zedkube processing the `EdgeNodeClusterConfig` on every node. `evetest cluster info` corroborates this live: each node reports its own distinct `node_id` and only itself in its node set (though sharing the same `cluster_id`), with storage health flapping between `SERVICE_STATUS_HEALTHY`/`SERVICE_STATUS_FAILED` — consistent with each node independently standing up its own full kubevirt/longhorn stack, which is why `evetest status` reports "Timed out waiting for cluster nodes to become ready" on `edge-dev2`.

This is unrelated to the earlier `TestEVEUpgradeKubevirtToKubevirt` failure investigated in this run (that was a one-shot webhook-connectivity/retry-countdown bug in `domainmgr`, a different test and mechanism). Per the ledger, this is a well-established **known, recurring issue** for `TestThreeNodesUpgrade` specifically — the identical "every node independently races into k3s single-node bootstrap mode before zedkube applies `EdgeNodeClusterConfig`" signature was first recorded 2026-11-19 (run #26) and has recurred repeatedly since (e.g. 2026-11-26/run #57), so tonight's failure is a continuation of that same long-standing `cluster-init.sh`/zedkube race, not a new regression.
